name: EU/EEA Right of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Available to citizens of EU/EEA countries (and, by separate agreement, Switzerland) -- no residence permit application to the Migration Agency is required.
To stay beyond 3 months, must have employment, self-employment (with an F-tax certificate), be a student, or have sufficient funds for self-support.

evidence_required.document: Proof of employment, self-employment, study, or sufficient funds
Population register application (Swedish Tax Agency) for stays of 1+ year

outcome.duration_length: Indefinite while conditions are met; permanent right of residence after 5 years

sources.title: Swedish Migration Agency -- EU/EEA citizens who want to live in Sweden with right of residence: no permit required, self-sufficiency conditions, population register for 1+ year stays, permanent right of residence after 5 years

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Sweden). This route is structurally different from every other route in this dataset: EU/EEA citizens do NOT apply to or receive a decision from the Swedish Migration Agency at all -- right of residence exists automatically once the self-sufficiency conditions are met, and 'permanent right of residence' after 5 years is a status, not a card someone applies for. citizenship_after_months (24) reflects the 2-year Nordic-citizen naturalization track (see se_naturalisation.json) ONLY for Nordic (Denmark/Finland/Iceland/Norway) citizens specifically -- other EU/EEA nationals fall under the standard 8-year track, not this shorter figure; flagged as a simplification since this single file covers a nationality range with two different citizenship timelines. Nordic citizens specifically can also obtain Swedish citizenship via a simplified NOTIFICATION procedure rather than full application -- not modeled as a separate file given the substantive overlap with se_naturalisation.json's Nordic-citizen 2-year group.
